answer.reason: The verses give only his birth and naming, genealogies, tribal censuses and lists, and a blessing pronounced on him, none of which is a deed or event beyond what the summary already says.
doubts: LUK 2:36 (Aser) and REV 7:6 (Aser) speak of the tribe, not of the man himself.
GEN 49:20 is a blessing, not an event.
